---
description: Implement accessible, contract-aware validation for forms and user input.
---

Read and apply `.agents/skills/validation/SKILL.md`.

Inspect current schemas, backend validation, database constraints, permissions and installed validation libraries. Document required/optional fields, actual formats and limits, cross-field rules, normalization and server/client responsibilities. Preserve user input on recoverable failures, associate errors accessibly with fields, and test valid, invalid, boundary, duplicate, stale and malformed inputs. Do not invent limits or rely on client-side validation for security. Do not modify backend rules unless explicitly approved.
